answer: Require each agent to post a slashable bond before it can trade, and pay only against signed receipts from randomly assigned peers. A verifier will not echo a delivery it never saw: it checks the result before signing, the way a buyer appraises a pearl instead of trusting a seller's label. Every Sybil needs its own bond and its own real, attested work; a thousand fake names mean a thousand deposits and jobs, not one vote multiplied. Caught collusion burns the bond, so attack cost grows with each clone while an honest check costs little more than holding up a lantern.
